items.name: Subset enumeration
items.description: Enumerate subset masks or assignments and evaluate each candidate directly.

items.name: Permutation enumeration
items.description: Enumerate permutations of a small set of elements.

items.name: Backtracking
items.description: Recursively explore candidates while maintaining and undoing local state.

items.name: Meet-in-the-middle
items.description: Split an exponential search into halves and combine partial results by lookup, sorting, or two-pointer matching.

items.name: Brute-force reconstruction
items.description: Recover an explicit witness, assignment, path, or operation sequence from enumerated states or matched partial results.
